QuestInfo.name: [Kerning Tower] Day of the Debut
QuestInfo.0: The day of the debut is finally here! Will Jackpot Entertainment's new group succeed? #bBlake#k doesn't look too good...
QuestInfo.1: Blake receives a call from the broadcasting station that the group has been acting strangely. What could be going on just before their debut? Head to the #rlive broadcast stage#k and check on them.
QuestInfo.2: According to Blake, the group started acting funny after playing the guitar in the Rehearsal Room. Investigate the guitar in the Rehearsal Room.

0.0: We've got trouble, #b#h0##k! I just got a call from the broadcasting station. They say that the group is acting really strange!
0.1: They were totally fine when I left them at the studio! I don't know what's going on, but this is no time for pre-performance jitters... \r\n#b#h0##k, come with me to the studio.

no.0: What are you saying? You can't abandon the girls now!

1.0: Oh, you're here, #b#h0##k! What the heck is going on?

0.msg: They're all so... depressed. They can't go out on stage like that!

1.msg: They were all grumbling something about a #bweird guitar they found in the Rehearsal Room#k... Is that really what this is about?

2.msg: #b(Investigate the suspicious guitar brought from the Rehearsal Room.)#k
